description: A fixed illustrative truck and day, separate from observed Karma vehicles.
loadError: The example day could not be loaded.
distanceExplanation: Sum of the two illustrative trip distances in this scenario.
tripCountExplanation: Completed illustrative trips in this scenario's selected day.
speedExplanation: Largest illustrative maximum speed from the same two trips.
compositionHint: Illustrative day and night distance from these trips; map points are not used to calculate distance.
hint: This example demonstrates known physical units. It does not confirm the units of real Karma fields.
mapHint: Public road landmarks illustrate a fictional journey. Suggested directions are not a recorded track.
loadedTripPositions: loaded positions in this trip; the source period and coverage below describe the original example day.
fuelReset: This illustrative cumulative fuel counter drops after example-position-03. Values after that reset cannot be subtracted from earlier values.
comparisonScope: Deltas use the same two boundary samples and UTC window for fuel, distance and engine hours. Consumption is fuel delta ÷ distance delta × 100; it is neither a trip nor a day total.
comparisonExcluded: The declared 06:20–06:40 UTC gap and the fuel reset at example-position-04 are excluded. Later samples and the full trip distance are not used in these deltas.
comparisonUnavailable: A matching counter comparison is available only for example-position-01 to example-position-03 in the first trip. No comparison is calculated for this selection.
unavailableSignal: Value unavailable for this example sample
